scripts.web:build: bun --cwd web tsc -b && bun --cwd web vite build
scripts.extension:dev: bun run extension:install && bun --cwd extension paperback-cli serve --watch --port ${MANGASHELF_DEV_EXTENSION_PORT:-38181}
scripts.extension:bundle: bun run extension:install && bun --cwd extension paperback-cli bundle
scripts.extension:serve: bun run extension:install && bun --cwd extension paperback-cli serve
scripts.extension:logcat: bun run extension:install && bun --cwd extension paperback-cli logcat
scripts.extension:format: bun --cwd extension oxfmt src tsconfig.json package.json
scripts.extension:format:check: bun --cwd extension oxfmt --check src tsconfig.json package.json
scripts.extension:test: bun run extension:typecheck && bun run extension:lint:check && bun run extension:format:check && bun run extension:test:smoke && bun run extension:bundle
